exposure: Pregnant women with placenta previa with RPOC vs. without RPOC
cohort: 335 singleton pregnant women with placenta previa who underwent cesarean section and placenta removal at the National Defense Medical College Hospital between January 2004 and December 2021
finding: Prior cesarean section and placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) were identified as risk factors for retained products of conception (RPOC) in placenta previa, and RPOC is closely associated with severe postpartum hemorrhage (PPH).
